name: blueprint/translate-docs
description: Batch document translation: chunk on boundaries, translate per chunk, store the translations, reassemble and publish via files
recipe: chunk the document on boundaries (translate preserves formatting) -> translate each chunk (one contained call) -> store chunk translations -> reassemble, publish, share
pitfalls: chunk before translating - one giant call fails the cap
formatting is the translator's job (text family contract)
a failed chunk fails clean - retry only that chunk
the presigned link is a secret for its window
